jobs.title: Analytics Engineer II - Health Equity Analytics
jobs.description: Job Title & Specialty Area: Analytics Engineer II - Health Equity Analytics Department: Health Equity Location: Dallas, TX Shift: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Job Type: Remote (Texas) Why Children's Health? At Children's Health, our mission is to Make Life Better for Children, and we recognize that their health plays a crucial role in achieving this goal. Through our cutting-edge treatments and affiliation with UT Southwestern, we strive to deliver an extraordinary patient and family experience, ensuring that every moment, big or small, contributes to their overall well-being. Our dedication to promoting children's health extends beyond our organization and encompasses the broader community. Together, we can make a significant difference in the lives of children and contribute to a brighter and healthier future for all. Summary Under the direction of Data & Analytics Engineering leadership, the Analytics Engineer II will own and operationalize analytics products that advance health equity operational, quality, and research initiatives. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in applying statistical and analytical methods, including regression modeling, hypothesis testing, survival analysis, risk adjustment, and other epidemiological techniques, to translate complex clinical, operational, and research questions into actionable insights and measurable outcomes. They will leverage strong SQL, Python, and analytics engineering skills to design and maintain semantic layers, data marts, metrics stores, and self-service analytics solutions while ensuring data quality, governance, and reproducibility. This individual will partner closely with clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to transform EHR, research, financial, and supply chain data into trusted, scalable analytics products that support decision-making, outcomes measurement, disparities analysis, and performance improvement efforts. The ideal candidate combines rigorous scientific and research-oriented thinking with modern engineering practices such as version control, CI/CD, automated testing, metadata management, and environment promotion, while serving as an effective communicator who can translate technical concepts for diverse audiences and mentor junior team members. Candidates who have demonstrated success in research activities, publications, presentations, health services research, or population health programs, along with the ability to connect analytics solutions to tangible healthcare impact, will be particularly well-suited for this role. The strongest candidates will demonstrate both advanced healthcare analytics expertise and the ability to operationalize analytics at scale. Responsibilities Core Responsibilities: Prepare and model analytically ready datasets; implement and maintain semantic layers, metrics stores or data marts; apply data engineering best practices to analytics (version control, CI/CD, environment management); collaborate with BI analysts, data scientists and domain stakeholders to operationalize analytics products; ensure alignment with governance and data quality requirements Level Specific Requirements Design and implement semantic layer components (metrics store objects, analytical models, data marts) to support domain KPIs and BI consumption Implement automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and deployment promotion for analytics products; own environment management for domain artifacts Lead data quality monitoring for analytics products and collaborate with data stewards to remediate issues; maintain metadata and lineage in the catalog Optimize query and semantic performance for BI tools; implement best practices to reduce dashboard sprawl and inconsistent metrics Collaborate with clinical and operational stakeholders to translate clinical workflows and EHR/ERP data into repeatable analytics products (e.g., procedure-level cost and outcomes dashboards, inventory visibility reports) Domain collaboration (e.g. clinical, financial, or supply chain), stakeholder facilitation and problem-solving skills Ability to translate business KPIs into reproducible metrics-as-code and communicate technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders Ability to mentor junior engineers Healthcare Domain Considerations Work with EHR/clinical data and supply‑chain/ERP data sources, follow interoperability expectations (FHIR/HL7 awareness for clinical integrations), support clinical analytics use cases (procedural analytics, outcomes measurement, preference card analytics) and supply‑chain analytics (spend, contract, inventory visibility) when relevant Engineering Practices To Measure And Apply Version control of analytics content, separate dev/test/prod environments, workflow orchestration, metadata/cataloging and performance testing to improve model uptime, adoption, code quality and defect resolution Governance & Risk Adhere to organizational data governance, privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA-relevant controls), and collaborate with governance or ARB where analytics/AI artifacts will be used in clinical or high-risk contexts Work Experience How You’ll Be Successful: At least 3 years In analytics/data roles with demonstrated delivery of analytics artifacts, experience with dbt or other analytics engineering tools, and hands-on CI/CD and orchestration tool usage. Required At least 3 years Advanced SQL, dbt or equivalent transformation frameworks, familiarity with metrics store concepts and knowledge-graph/ontology basics for semantic enrichment where applicable Required At least 3 years Ability to implement CI/CD for analytics, automated testing, environment promotion and metadata/catalog integration Required At least 3 years Proficiency with at least one cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks, MS Fabric) and BI tool optimizations (Power BI/Tableau performance tuning) Required At least 1 year Exposure to machine learning, data science, or artificial intelligence concepts Preferred At least 1 year Experience working in healthcare or other regulated industry Preferred EDUCATION Four-year Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or related field Required LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS Analytics related certifications (e.g. Dbt Analytics Engineering, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, Snowflake SnowPro, Databricks, Epic Cogito) or a learning plan requirement to be provided with offer includes missing relevant certifications needed to perform role, and certifications must be obtained within 180 days of starting first class Required A Place Where You Belong We put our people first. We welcome, value, and respect the beliefs, identities and experiences of our patients and colleagues. We are committed to delivering culturally effective care, creating meaningful partnerships in the communities we serve, and equipping and developing our team members to make Children’s Health a place where everyone can contribute. Holistic Benefits – How We’ll Care For You Employee portion of medical plan premiums are covered after 3 years. 4%-10% employee savings plan match based on tenure Paid Parental Leave (up to 12 weeks) Caregiver Leave Adoption and surrogacy reimbursement As an equal opportunity employer, Children's Health does not discriminate against employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, veteran or military status, disability, or genetic information or any other Federal or State legally-protected status or class. This applies to all aspects of the employer-employee relationship including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, promotion, transfer pay, training, discipline, workforce adjustments, termination, employee benefits, and any other employment-related activity.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: - Permanent - TX & NC Are you passionate about laboratory operations and equipment management, with a keen eye for documentation, compliance, and process improvement? Proclinical is seeking a Data Scientist to support a multi-site research program focused on collecting neural and behavioral data from clinical settings. This role will serve as the principal technical authority on data quality, ensuring incoming data meets rigorous standards for downstream research and AI modeling. Primary Responsibilities The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in developing scalable quality control methods and infrastructure as the program expands. This position is ideal for someone with expertise in computational neuroscience and a passion for working with real-world clinical data. Skills & Requirements Strong background in computational neuroscience or related field. Proficiency in handling and analyzing messy, real-world clinical data. Experience developing and deploying quality control metrics for complex datasets. Familiarity with machine learning techniques for anomaly detection and process optimization. Ability to design model-based validation methods for scientific data. Excellent communication skills to provide clear and reproducible data assessments. Proven ability to collaborate with diverse teams, including site personnel and research stakeholders. Adaptability to refine methodologies and scale infrastructure as the program grows. The Data Scientist's Responsibilities Will Be Evaluate incoming data from partner sites using defined technical criteria to ensure quality standards for research and modeling. Develop and implement formal quality metrics for neural and behavioral data, including electrophysiological recordings and behavioral task data. Design and apply model-based validation techniques to confirm data suitability for scientific use. Utilize machine learning for anomaly detection and streamline quality control processes as data volume increases. Provide clear, objective, and reproducible rationale for data quality determinations. Monitor and report on quality control outcomes across sites, identifying patterns, training needs, and areas for improvement. Collaborate with site personnel and stakeholders to troubleshoot and resolve data quality issues. Refine quality control standards and methodologies as the program evolves. Work with research team members to explore innovative uses of the collected data. If you are having difficulty in applying or if you have any questions, please contact Jared Hannigan at j.hannigan@proclinical.com. If you are interested in applying to this exciting opportunity, then please click 'Apply' or to speak to one of our specialists please request a call back at the top of this page. Proclinical is a leading life sciences recruiter focused on finding exceptional people and matching them with the finest positions across the globe. Proclinical is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy. By submitting this application, you confirm that you've read and understood our privacy policy, which informs you how we process and safeguard your data - https://www.proclinical.com/privacy-policy

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Education Analytics is a non-profit organization that strives to deliver sophisticated, research-informed analytics to educators and school administrators to support their work in improving student outcomes. Data Engineers at EA enable this mission by ensuring that the data educators receive is accurate, up to date, secure, and easily accessible. We are seeking a full-time Data Engineer or Analytics Engineer to join our Engineering team focused on Data & Partners. Candidates for this role may be hired at a Data Engineer II or Senior Data Engineer level depending on skills and experience. The person in this role will design, build, and maintain automated data pipelines and analytic systems for our partner education agencies. This will involve working directly on partner education agency projects to build data systems using EA’s tools, and use the experience of building real systems to advise and contribute to core product development. An ideal candidate has strong SQL skills, experience with data warehousing concepts, and familiarity with complex data integration work. Data engineers are responsible for extract/load processes, data warehouse design, data transformations, and data modeling. While we want our team members to have familiarity with all aspects of ELT, we welcome specialists who may be more experienced on either the data engineering or analytics engineering side. Our typical stack uses an ELT approach via Apache Airflow and dbt to create data warehouses in Snowflake and Databricks. Our team is working to change the education sector by building frameworks to enable collaboration across school systems. To do this, we use open data standards and open-source tools so that solutions we create can be used and re-used in different education agencies across the country. We build and maintain the Enable Data Union project and open-source projects like Earthmover. Our team’s work includes building tools and creating and managing data systems using those tools. This sampling of posts from the Education Analytics blog provides some insight into the role: What we’ve learned building AI on top of Education Data A day in the life of a Data Engineer with Ryan Aguilar A day in the life of a Data Engineer with Angelica Lastra Building Shared Data Infrastructure for Public Education Qualifications 2+ years experience designing data pipelines, systems, and warehouses Knowledge of best design practices in cloud-based data warehouses Knowledge of software engineering practices, particularly in team-based development using Git Fluency in SQL and experience working with real world data Experience with Python Experience with Linux Experience with database administration, security, and management Skills and experience that make you a particularly good fit: Experience with cloud-based columnar data warehouses and other cloud data technologies (Snowflake, RedShift, Databricks, Fabric, BigQuery) Experience working in environments with strict data security requirements Experience with dbt Experience with Apache Airflow Familiarity with AWS tooling and best practices Experience with education data, and the Ed-Fi data standard in particular Experience and interest in using AI code tools as part of development and automation workflows Hiring Process Hiring team reviews applications Selected candidates are invited to submit an asynchronous video interview Selected candidates move on to a second round, which may involve a live remote technical skills assessment Selected candidates are invited for a full day final interview (in person in our downtown Madison office). There will be another approximately 2-3 hours of interviews to meet team members and key members of other teams and to help candidates learn more about Education Analytics & the role. How You Will Successfully Onboard In This Role First 30 days: Work through organizational and team onboarding. Get situated into team meetings and one on ones with your manager. Complete a training exercise that familiarizes our new hires with our development setup and tooling. First 60 days: Begin to get involved in your first projects, familiarizing yourself with the project history, context, and goals by joining project meetings and connecting with teammates. Continue familiarizing yourself with our team’s workflow processes and tools. First 90 days: Now fully integrated into your first projects, making regular code and documentation contributions. You may start sharing your development at team meetings. We will start planning for you to take a lead role on sub-tasks within a project. Additional Details The weekly expectation is 45 hours per week, and nights and weekends are sometimes required. Our office is in Madison, WI and applicants who live in the area, or are interested in moving here, can work in the office alongside other members of the team. Currently, our engineers include a mix of people who are working from office, hybrid, and fully remote. We are open to remote or on-site candidates for this position. Benefits 9 annual paid holidays, 26.5 days of paid vacation per year, and paid sick time 12% employer 401k contribution + 3% match Generous health benefits Parental leave benefit of up to 26 weeks of paid leave Free Madison Metro transit pass or subsidized office parking (for in person employees) Casual office environment Location right in the heart of downtown Madison, WI Statement on AI Use in Applications We want to hear directly from you! At Education Analytics, we value candidates’ individual experiences, perspectives, and communication styles. To help us fairly assess your qualifications, we ask that candidates prepare their application materials and responses using their own words and experiences. AI tools may be used for proofreading, formatting, and general preparation. However, candidates should not rely on AI to generate substantive answers to application questions, fabricate or embellish qualifications, or complete assessments intended to evaluate their independent skills. Any additional restrictions on AI use during interviews or assessments will be communicated in advance. We appreciate the time and thought you put into applying and look forward to learning more about you. Education Analytics is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Data Engineer II - Databricks
jobs.description: CLA is a top 10 national professional services firm where our purpose is to create opportunities every day, for our clients, our people, and our communities through industry-focused wealth advisory, digital, audit, tax, consulting, and outsourcing services. Even with more than 8,500 people, 130 U.S. locations, and a global reach, we promise to know you and help you. CLA is dedicated to building a culture that invites different beliefs and perspectives to the table, so we can truly know and help our clients, communities, and each other. About The Role CLA is looking to hire a Data Engineer II to join our growing team. The Data Engineer II supports the design, development, and maintenance of scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. This role contributes to data pipeline development, data integration, platform reliability, and the delivery of trusted data solutions that support CLA’s business needs. The ideal candidate has experience working with cloud-based data platforms, enjoys solving technical problems, and is eager to continue developing their data engineering skills while collaborating with experienced team members. As a Data Engineer II, You Will Build, test, deploy, and maintain data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, and Python. Support the integration of data across databases, data warehouses, APIs, ETL processes, middleware, and other enterprise systems. Help ensure data engineering solutions meet established performance, reliability, security, compliance, and governance requirements. Collaborate with data engineers, architects, analysts, business partners, and other technology teams to deliver scalable data solutions. Contribute to technical design discussions, platform decisions, and continuous improvement initiatives. Participate in the delivery of releases aligned with business goals, technical standards, and data governance policies. Monitor data pipelines and assist with troubleshooting performance, reliability, and data-quality issues. Contribute to system reliability and maintainability through effective documentation, testing, source control, and code-quality practices. Support data modeling, transformation, and data warehouse development activities. Develop and maintain technical documentation, including data mappings, pipeline documentation, operational procedures, and support materials. Participate in Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives. Continuously build knowledge of cloud data engineering technologies, emerging tools, and industry best practices. Experience What you will need: Two years of relevant data engineering, software engineering, data integration, or related technology experience required. Experience working with cloud engineering technologies across Microsoft Azure or AWS required. Experience with Databricks required. Experience developing data pipelines using SQL and Python required. Experience with databases, data warehouses, ETL processes, APIs, middleware, and enterprise system integrations preferred. Education Bachelor’s degree required. A combination of relevant experience, education, and training may be accepted in lieu of a degree. Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field preferred. Certifications No certifications are required. One Or More Of The Following Certifications Are Preferred Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate Technical Skills Proficiency with Microsoft Azure or AWS cloud technologies. Proficiency with Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, and Python. Experience with Apache Spark and cloud-based data-processing technologies. Familiarity with GitHub or comparable source-control and development platforms. Familiarity with Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms. Understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, databases, and ETL or ELT processes. Familiarity with data-visualization tools such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or Matplotlib. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Ability to document technical solutions clearly and collaborate with both technical and business stakeholders. Travel Less than 10%. jobs.title: Data Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Make an Impact With Us At Vallourec, we are seeking individuals whose passion and dedication match the strength and resilience of the steel we produce. The Data Analytics Engineer is part of the global Data & Analytics team and operates at the intersection of data engineering, business analytics and business intelligence. The role develops certified use-case datasets in the Gold layer, contributes domain metrics to the Semantic layer and builds reliable Power BI dashboards from validated business requirements. The position works closely with Data Engineers, Domain Specialists, the Semantic Layer & BI Lead, Data Governance, Data Product Owners and business stakeholders across regions and functions. Your Role at a Glance Analytics engineering and Gold-layer development Develop and maintain certified use-case data models in dbt, including dimensional models, fact tables and reusable business metrics Semantic layer and metric governance Author domain metrics, dimensions, hierarchies and time-intelligence logic according to the approved framework, maintaining definitions and lineage Business intelligence delivery Build and optimize Power BI dashboards based on certified Gold data and governed semantic metrics Quality, documentation and enablement Implement automated data-quality tests, maintain technical documentation and support self-service adoption and training materials Operational tasks Develop and maintain the domain Use-case (Gold) layer in dbt, following approved modeling and naming standards Build dimensional models, fact tables and business metrics from the Domain (Silver) layer Implement and maintain dbt data-quality tests and achieve the agreed test-coverage targets Document dbt models and publish the documentation and metadata in Unity Catalog Coordinate data contracts between the Domain and Use-case layers with Data Engineers, including column types, refresh expectations and nullability Escalate questions about Silver-layer business logic to the relevant Domain Specialist rather than independently redefining the logic Create domain metrics in the semantic layer, including dimensions, hierarchies and time intelligence Submit domain metrics and cross-domain definitions for review by the Semantic Layer & BI Lead before Gold certification Maintain metric definitions, lineage and registry records Build, test and optimize Power BI dashboards using certified Gold datasets and semantic metrics Apply data-security requirements, including appropriate access controls and row-level security when required Support business analysts and end users with self-service guidance and training materials. Management No direct people management responsibility. Expected to coordinate technical work across business and technology stakeholders and contribute to peer reviews and knowledge sharing. Expected deliverables Certified Gold-layer dbt models; tested and documented data products; governed semantic metrics; optimized Power BI dashboards; data contracts; lineage and metric documentation; user enablement materials Tools SQL, dbt, Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Power BI, DAX, Git, CI/CD pipelines and a semantic-layer framework such as MetricFlow or the approved platform equivalent What Sets You Apart We're looking for individuals who bring the right mix of experience, mindset, and motivation: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Analytics or a related field Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered Training or certification in dbt, Power BI, Databricks, dimensional modeling or cloud data platforms is an advantage Advanced SQL skills Hands-on experience with dbt, including models, tests and documentation Intermediate to advanced dimensional modeling, including fact tables, dimensions, grain and star schemas Intermediate Power BI and DAX skills, including data modeling and report-performance optimization Experience with Git-based version control and collaborative development practices Working knowledge of data quality, metadata and lineage concepts Experience with Databricks SQL and Unity Catalog Experience with a semantic layer or metric framework such as dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for analytics engineering Experience with data contracts and cross-domain metric governance Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric or cloud data platforms Experience supporting self-service analytics and user enablement What Powers Your Performance Success in this role is driven by a strong mix of personal ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We value team members who possess: 2+ years of experience in analytics engineering, business intelligence, data modeling or a closely related role 2+ years of experience delivering analytics products in collaboration with data engineering and business stakeholders 2+ years of experience working with governed datasets, reusable metrics and dashboard solutions in a corporate environment Ownership and accountability for reliable, reusable data products Strong collaboration between business and technology teams Clear communication of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Analytical thinking and structured problem solving Attention to data quality, documentation and detail Continuous-improvement mindset and willingness to challenge the status quo constructively Ability to work in a global, cross-functional and multicultural environment How We Support Your Success We're committed to helping you thrive on the job and beyond. That's why we offer a collaborative culture where your ideas drive real change, and career mobility within a stable, essential industry. To support your growth and well-being, we also provide a comprehensive and competitive benefits program, including: Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage Company-Paid Life Insurance & Short/Long-Term Disability Profit Sharing: Up to 4% 401(k): Company match 4.5% with no vesting period Paid Parental Leave Paid Holidays: 10 days plus 1 floating holiday Paid Vacation Time Performance-Based Bonus Program Tuition Reimbursement Safety isn't negotiable, it's who we are. Every spark, every shift, and every decision is guided by a commitment that goes well beyond compliance. Protecting our people is more than a priority, it's a promise we make to every colleague, every day.
